title: Work Seamlessly with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Teams

chapters.title: Sales order scenario and credit limit approval workflow
Quote creation and template management in Outlook

features.name: Contact Insights function
features.description: Allows seamless movement from email to customer records to review orders and add senders to contacts.

features.name: Business Central records in Teams chat links
features.description: Users can paste links to customer cards and product information into Teams chat for team members to access and drill down into details.

features.name: Read-only access through Microsoft 365 account
features.description: Non-licensed users can view Business Central records through read-only access via their Microsoft 365 account without requiring a Business Central license.

features.name: Sales order modification and credit limit notifications
features.description: Users can open and modify sales orders, receiving real-time notifications when changes exceed customer credit limits.

features.name: Power Automate escalation workflow
features.description: Automation created with Microsoft Power Automate that creates a new collaborative Teams space with a single click to facilitate group chat flow for issue escalation.

features.name: Business data tabs in Teams chat
features.description: Users can add tabs to Teams chat that display Business Central data such as customer invoices and payments, providing contextual business information during collaboration.

features.name: Export to Excel for analysis
features.description: Users can export customer payment lists and other data to Microsoft Excel for detailed analysis and historical review.

features.name: Business Central in Outlook
features.description: Gabe can access customer records, purchase history, billing history, payment information and account balance directly from Outlook for reference during email communication.

features.name: Item discounts in Excel
features.description: Users can open the list of item discounts in Excel and copy special prices and discounts between customers, with edits saved back to Business Central.

features.name: Email attachment linking to customer records
features.description: Users can link important email attachments directly to customer records in Business Central from Outlook, making information accessible to coworkers in the sales cycle.

features.name: Quote composition with email detection
features.description: Users can quickly compose quotes from Outlook based on products that are automatically detected in the customer's email.

features.name: Export quote layout to Word
features.description: Users can export quote PDF layouts to Microsoft Word, modify the templates, save them back to Business Central, and share them with the team.

features.name: Share link functionality for templates
features.description: Users can share links to updated templates and documents with coworkers for team review and awareness.
